findings: GHSA-mv93-w799-cj2w is a real, still-published vendor/GitHub-reviewed vulnerability: unvalidated section/option names reach GitPython's raw '[%s]\n' % name serializer and can inject core.hooksPath. No CVE is assigned; CVE.org/NVD have no record; withdrawn queries are empty.

Atomic BIC is 3fd37230e76a014cf5c45d55daf0be2caa6948b7 (parent 9513aa01fab73f53e4fe18644c7d5b530a66c6a1). The parent parser cannot write section headers; the BIC first enables mutating set and adds the unsanitized header sink. Later set_value (6a417f4cf2df39704aa4c869e88d14e9806894a7) is a convenience wrapper, not origin.
